sources.entry: Lunavect - Menu bar app and desktop widgets showing which Claude Code or Codex session is working, waiting for input, or done, with usage limits and activity. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/lovach/Lunavect) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]
Lunavect - Menu bar app for Claude Code and Codex: live status of every session, weekly and five-hour usage limits, desktop widgets and activity statistics.

summary.one_liner: Lunavect is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app and desktop widget set that shows the live state of Claude Code and Codex sessions, plus their weekly and five-hour usage limits.
summary.what_it_does: The app lists every Claude Code and Codex session on the Mac with its live state (working, thinking, waiting for permission or input, or done), and lets you search, filter, pin and hide sessions. It shows weekly and five-hour usage allowances for both providers with reset times, displayed in the menu bar as bars, percentages or rings. Desktop widgets in small, medium and large sizes show limits, activity or both. Statistics cover working time by day, week, month, year and all time, and the Agent Monitor shows tokens per session, project and model. A "Limit Usage…" option can make an agent finish its current step and stop at a chosen share of the week, and "Continue Later…" resumes a session after reset. Notifications cover ready responses, approvals needed, failed turns and low limits.
use_cases: Monitor which Claude Code or Codex agent is waiting for input
Track weekly and five-hour Claude or Codex usage limits
Check Claude Code or Codex session activity and working time
Put agent status and usage widgets on the macOS desktop
Limit an agent's token spend before the weekly allowance runs out
how_to_run: Or download Lunavect-0.2.8.dmg from the releases and drag Lunavect to Applications
Open Lunavect and choose Connect Claude or Connect Codex (Claude needs the Claude Code CLI; Codex needs the Codex app or CLI)
Development: git clone the repo, cd Lunavect, then run ./scripts/check.sh (requires full Xcode and a Swift toolchain)
notable: Shows live state of every Claude Code and Codex session in the menu bar
Can stop an agent at a chosen share of the weekly usage, finishing its step and writing what is left, without killing it
Desktop widgets in small, medium and large sizes with solid or glass backgrounds
Connects through the agents' own hooks and keeps sign-in with the official clients
Localized in English, Russian, German, Spanish, French and Simplified Chinese
caveats: Claude needs the Claude Code CLI; Claude Desktop alone is not enough
Limit values are shown as unavailable when fresh client data is missing rather than estimated
Widgets read saved data and refresh only when macOS schedules them
